blocks.html: Best rate guaranteed with the new Robinsons Hotels Mobile App

Planning your next staycation, or raring to go on that long-awaited trip with your family and friends? Score great deals and more when you download and book your stay through the new Robinsons Hotels mobile app! The Robinsons Hotels mobile app is outfitted with features that will give you access to RHR’s suite of hotels and resorts right at your fingertips. It’s the best and easiest way to ensure your trip runs as smoothly as possible.

After an initial sign-in process, users need only to input their trip details into the app, search for their travel dates, and they’re able to book multiple rooms in any of RHR’s 25 properties with just one click! Browse through the app to see what each of these properties has to offer, so you can choose the perfect hotel that will suit your needs. Options are also available for add-ons within the app, such as breakfast, extra beds, and more. You can even input promo codes to take advantage of the best deals. Users also have the option to either pay for their stay through the app or settle their bill at the hotel. For added safety and convenience, users may opt for a contactless check-in. They simply need to use their uniquely generated QR codes at select self-check-in kiosks situated within the hotel lobby.

Click on to https://uqr.to/RobinsonsHotelsApp and be one of the first to experience the Robinsons Hotels mobile app, and discover an exciting world of opportunities at your fingertips. The Robinsons Hotels mobile app is also available on the App Store and Google Play.
